title: Label-specific frontend code splitting for JasonShell surfaces
description: Implement label-specific frontend code splitting for JasonShell surfaces. Problem: FN-004 measured a single 856 kB production JS chunk and found `src/App.svelte` statically imports every heavy surface for every Tauri window. Target metric: reduce top/bottom/search/process non-terminal JS parse/loaded bytes and improve cold startup. Likely file scope: `src/App.svelte`, `src/main.ts` if needed, surface component loading helpers/tests. Acceptance criteria: each Tauri label still renders the same surface, unsupported labels still show fallback, `npm run build` emits separate/lazy chunks for heavy surfaces, existing surface lifecycle/search/terminal/process/stack tests pass, and the task records before/after dist chunk sizes.
summary: FN-001 was already fully implemented and committed through Step 5. I verified the completed work in this worktree with clean git status, `npm run check`, `npm run test:node`, and the required final `npm run build`; all passed. Chunk metrics remain recorded in the `chunk-metrics` task document, including the reduction from the 856.49 kB monolithic JS chunk to lazy surface chunks with a 72.76 kB bootstrap entry.
